title: Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research
abstract: arXiv:2610.01284v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computation

translated_title: 机器学习中的模型验证：生物医学与应用研究中从留出法切分到嵌套组交叉验证的场景化指南
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01284v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：模型验证用于估计一个完整学习流程在新数据上的性能。然而，无效的数据切分可能产生过于乐观且看似稳定的结果。本教程回顾了留出法验证、训练/验证/测试设计、重复随机子采样、k折与重复分层交叉验证、留一法与留p法方案、组感知验证以及嵌套组交叉验证。文中将一般机器学习原理与脑电图（EEG）片段、双眼配对OCT图像、重复临床测量和多中心数据联系起来。八个受控场景对比了有缺陷的设计与无泄漏安全设计：其中七个使用固定的混淆矩阵与可审计的指标，另一个使用可复现的重复研究模拟。这些场景涵盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、记录依赖、中心数据混淆、重复使用测试集以及估计器不稳定性。还讨论了偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性与计算代价。
tldr: 本文是一份面向生物医学与应用研究的场景化教程，系统梳理了从留出法切分到嵌套组交叉验证的各类模型验证方法，并通过八个对照场景展示了无效切分与数据泄漏如何导致过于乐观的性能评估及其规避策略。
en_tdlr: This tutorial systematically reviews model validation schemes from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation, and uses eight controlled scenarios to show how invalid splits and data leakage produce optimistic performance estimates in biomedical and applied research.
